appDescription: Drive Song turns each family drive into a song that plays on arrival and mixes in short voice clips recorded by family members.

function.name: PLAY_DRIVE_SONG
function.description: Plays the most recent drive song, followed by the earlier ones.

function.name: RECORD_FAMILY_VOICE
function.description: Records a five-second voice clip of a registered family member that is mixed into the next drive song.

nickname.description: The name the family member is registered under in the app, in the user's language.

slot.description: Where the clip plays: INTRO is a departure greeting, CALL is a cheer after the chorus, OUTRO is an arrival greeting.
